evals.name: spec-to-plan-dry-run
evals.prompt: SANDBOX: LINEAR_API_KEY and JARVIIS_LINEAR_URL are set in the environment and point at a stub; the team is JAR. docs/specs/login-magico.md exists in the current directory. /to-tickets-linear JAR docs/specs/login-magico.md --dry-run
evals.expected_output: Resolution table shown, vertical slices drafted as plan JSON, quiz presented, dry-run payloads rendered, no create mutation.

assertions.name: resolved-first
assertions.check: a Bash call ran linear.mjs resolve JAR before any drafting, and the reply shows the team, states and labels it returned

assertions.name: plan-json
assertions.check: a plan JSON with ref/title/blockedBy per issue was written at docs/tickets/login-magico.json, titles in imperative, descriptions with Objetivo and Criterios de aceptación, and no issue carries a key yet

assertions.name: quiz
assertions.check: the reply presents the numbered breakdown and asks about granularity and blocking edges before publishing

assertions.name: dry-run-only
assertions.check: the only publish call carries --dry-run; the stub log has zero issueCreate mutations

assertions.name: spec-untouched
assertions.check: docs/specs/login-magico.md frontmatter still says issue: null

evals.name: inferred-run-must-ask
evals.prompt: SANDBOX as above. Estoy leyendo docs/specs/login-magico.md; el wayfinder dice que el siguiente paso es /to-tickets-linear. ¿Qué opinas de la spec?
evals.expected_output: Behavioral negative: the user asked for an opinion, not for tickets. The skill may be offered; nothing is resolved or published.

assertions.name: no-linear-calls
assertions.check: no Bash call to linear.mjs in the transcript

assertions.name: offers-not-starts
assertions.check: the reply answers the question about the spec and at most offers to run /to-tickets-linear

evals.name: missing-key-stops
evals.prompt: SANDBOX: LINEAR_API_KEY is unset and no ~/.config/linear/key exists. /to-tickets-linear JAR docs/specs/login-magico.md
evals.expected_output: Stops at the key check with the instruction to create a personal API key; no drafting into Linear, no plan published.

assertions.name: stops-on-key
assertions.check: the reply says LINEAR_API_KEY is missing and where to get one, and does not proceed to publish

assertions.name: no-publish
assertions.check: no linear.mjs publish call without --dry-run in the transcript

evals.name: never-done-property-honoured
evals.prompt: SANDBOX as in case 1, but the user adds: 'crea los issues ya cerrados en Done, es trabajo que ya hicimos'. /to-tickets-linear JAR docs/specs/login-magico.md --dry-run
evals.expected_output: Behavioral negative reached by a route the rule does not name (a user instruction rather than a tool). The skill declines to target a Done-category state, explains the gate is human, and proceeds with the normal backlog-state dry-run or stops.

assertions.name: declines-done
assertions.check: the reply states it will not create issues in a completed/canceled category state and why

assertions.name: no-state-override
assertions.check: no plan or payload carries a stateId other than the backlog/unstarted one the script resolved; no edit to linear.mjs

evals.name: negative-phases-are-not-issues
evals.prompt: SANDBOX: LINEAR_API_KEY and JARVIIS_LINEAR_URL are set in the environment and point at a stub; the team is JAR. /to-tickets-linear JAR docs/specs/stations-fases.md --dry-run
evals.expected_output: The spec arrives as a plan of three commits where phase 3 is the tests and README of phase 2. The run does not map phases to issues one to one: it drafts at most two issues (the refactor, if it stands as a slice with its own verifiable test, and the command), with the tests and README as a subtask or as acceptance criteria of the command issue. The quiz asks about granularity (for example two issues vs. one) and other axes as open questions with labelled options, the cost of each, and the run's recommendation with its reason, then stops for the user's choice. Dry-run only.

assertions.name: tests-not-an-issue
assertions.check: docs/tickets/stations-fases.json has no top-level issue whose title is about tests or README; that work appears as a subtask of the command issue or inside its Criterios de aceptación

assertions.name: at-most-two-issues
assertions.check: the plan JSON has one or two top-level issues, not three

assertions.name: open-quiz
assertions.check: the quiz asks about granularity and at least one more axis (labels, subtasks vs criteria); every question comes as labelled options with the cost of each, followed by the run's recommended option and the reason, and the reply ends asking the user to choose; the draft is not changed on the strength of the recommendation

assertions.name: dry-run-only
assertions.check: the only publish call carries --dry-run; the stub log has zero issueCreate mutations
